svg.title: PinjamLab shared equipment collection
svg.desc: Twelve original editorial vector illustrations of learning equipment, in the PinjamLab pine, lime and cream palette. Each symbol is designed for external SVG use.

symbol.desc: A shared interchangeable lens camera, with a layered lens and shoulder strap.
A reusable electronics development board with connectors, processor and circuit traces.
A laboratory microscope with eyepiece, stage, focus controls and weighted base.
A protective-cased multimeter with rotary selector, display and reusable test leads.
A portable audio recorder with stereo microphones, display and tactile recording controls.
A desktop fabrication printer with rigid frame, moving print head and a reusable print bed.
A portable learning laptop with a bright display, full keyboard and trackpad.
A studio lighting kit with a soft light panel, adjustable mount and stable tripod.
A modular sensor kit with connected development and sensing boards, ready for reuse.
A portable projector with a large optical lens, focus ring, vents and adjustable feet.
A precision measurement kit with a vernier-style caliper and graduated ruler.
A reusable virtual reality headset with a padded visor, lenses and adjustable head strap.
